HOME.FILM_TITLE: Three rules for an exact count
HOME.FILM_STEADY_TEXT: On a tripod or propped up, landscape, about one and a half metres high. Don't hold it.
HOME.FILM_STEADY_ART: A phone on a tripod, landscape, pointed at the hoop
HOME.FILM_FRAME_TEXT: The whole hoop and you from head to toe, for the whole video. With more than one hoop, pick yours.
HOME.FILM_FRAME_ART: The phone screen shows the whole hoop and the player from head to toe
HOME.FILM_LIGHT_TEXT: Even light, ideally from above, never the sun or a floodlight behind the hoop. A sharp ball means an exact count.
HOME.FILM_LIGHT_ART: Lights from above light the court evenly
HOME.PLANS_NOTE: Cancel anytime. Go Pro and your whole history is there: nothing is deleted.
HOME.A1: No. The analysis runs in the browser of your phone or computer and the video never leaves the device. When you save, only the numbers go into your diary: shots, baskets, accuracy.
HOME.Q2: Do I need to install an app?
HOME.A2: No, SwishAI works in the browser. To keep it close at hand, add it to your Home screen: it opens like an app.
HOME.Q3: How should I film my practice?
HOME.A3: Phone still on a tripod, landscape, with the whole hoop and you from head to toe in frame, and plenty of light. The cleaner the video, the more exact the count.
HOME.Q4: What if the model gets a shot wrong?
HOME.A4: After the analysis you review the video on the shot strip and fix it with a tap: basket, miss or not a shot. You can also add a shot it missed.
HOME.Q5: Can I analyse a video without signing up?
HOME.A5: Yes: without an account we analyse the first minute of each video. To save practices in your diary, join the rankings and have a profile, you need a free account.
HOME.A6: Whole videos analysed, your whole diary with complete charts and records, 1080p highlights with every effect (replay, zoom, transitions, colour) and the logo only if you want it. Plus the PDF report of your diary. Cancel anytime.
HOME.Q7: How do points and rankings work?
HOME.A7: You earn points by saving practices, unlocking milestones and climbing the weekly rankings. Manual corrections don't change your points.
